author: LightPacker621535
comment: Really enjoyed our stay at this beautiful boutique hotel, super position on Palmar beach, quiet and relaxed.The food is excellent, no buffets here everything is made to order and Sanjay and the team always have a smile to welcome you for breakfast.The giant prawn curry comes with my highest recommendation and the executive chef has offered to send me home with the recipe.Planning on coming back with the whole family 😊Read more

author: Tom M
comment: Incredible views, amazing food and friendly staff, would definitely recommendThe resort provided so much we never felt the need to go anywhere else.With their ocean activities, occasional entertainers and number of different locations to relax by the pool or the ocean we were never left wantingRead more

author: Chirag M
comment: We went to Salt of Palmar Mauritius, for our honeymoon based on the recommendations we saw on TripAdvisor and we could not be more glad with our decision. It was beyond what we expected and worth every penny we spent. As soon as you enter the Resort doors, you see the brightly colored walls, the pool, and then the Ocean right in front of you. You cannot ask for a better view IMHO. The hotel lacks of a conventional Front Desk, which makes the experience of dealing with the staff more cozy. Salt has a private beach surrounded with cool spots to relax by, a helpful staff that is there to address all your needs, its own boathouse for water activities, a relaxing spa,  special experiences for Honeymooners, and much more. We would recommend exploring the hotel on your first day We would like to highlight some staff members, Preethika, Akash, Akshaye and Qwelyn, who went above and beyond to service us and make our experience pleasant.Read more

author: Resort17117409232
comment: Our stay was amazing One of the best hotels I've been in my life Special thanks for the stuff that was more then awesome, especially Sanjay that made our stay fantastic, he is definitely one of a kindThe beach is amazingEverything is clean and shiny Sure we'll come back!Read more

author: Rob Battes
comment: Salt of Palmar is a fantastic destination. Staff very friendly and attentive. No TV in the room, but an excellent DAB radio. Wonderful without TV. You will be welcomed like a prince. we would like to mention someone in particular, Mr Med. they knew we had been married for 50 years. And we knew that. From the moment we entered we were put in the spotlight. room decorated, cocktail making workshop.(The boy from the rooftop bar👍) And finally we were taken from the table and taken to the beach. a beach house there was decorated especially for us. our dinner was brought there. The chef kook made a special cake for us. Never to be forgotten. We will never forget this beautiful small-scale resort and we can recommend it to everyone. We would like to thank everyone for this unforgettable experience. chapeau.❤️Rob and Ann BattesTheNetherlandsRead more

author: Christina C
comment: We stayed here for 12 nights. The hotel truly offers everything we had imagined. The à la carte breakfast is very diverse and extremely delicious. All the service staff are always eager to fulfill every wish and are very friendly. In particular, Sanjay takes great joy in his work. The rooms are very beautiful, clean, and the beds are extremely comfortable. The dinner has also always been very delicious.Read more

author: Culture30419933206
comment: 5-Stars for SALT of Palmar, Mauritius!From the moment we arrived at SALT of Palmar, we felt like cherished guests in a hidden paradise. The entire experience was flawless, thanks to the incredible team who went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. Every single staff member was friendly, attentive, and eager to help, addressing us by name and genuinely caring about every aspect of our comfort. They couldn't have done more for us, and each interaction was met with a warm smile.The hotel itself is immaculate—spotlessly clean with a soothing fragrance throughout. It truly feels like an oasis, a sanctuary for couples seeking intimacy and exclusivity. With only 60 rooms, the atmosphere is serene and personal, allowing you to feel as if you have the entire place to yourselves.The on-site chefs are phenomenal; every meal was a culinary delight, prepared to perfection. The kitchen staff each morning were particularly outstanding, ensuring we began every day with an amazing breakfast experience. The pool was kept at the perfect temperature, providing a refreshing dip that we looked forward to daily.The rooms are thoughtfully designed, with luxurious showers and breathtaking views onto the beach that make you feel connected to the stunning landscape of Mauritius. We loved waking up each morning to such a beautiful scene—it was pure bliss. The hotel is also situated on the east coast which allows you the catch the most amazing view of the sunrise if you wake up early enough.A huge thank you to the entire team at SALT of Palmar for their exceptional hospitality. The staff members in particular who went above and beyond were - Akash, Rewa, Med, Shirley, Sanjay, Bhishav, Prince, Qwelyn, Ved and Dervin. This hotel is a gem, and I couldn’t recommend it more. If you’re looking for an intimate, personalized, and genuinely magical stay, this is the place to be.Thank you for an unforgettable experience!Warm Regards - SafRead more

author: Sanj L
comment: Was there on 01 November 2024 with my wife. Everything was perfect ranging from the courteous staff to the cosy room. Food was just perfect. Do not expect dinner buffet. Dinner is a la carte. Hotel was celebrating its 6 years anniversary when we were there. Kudos to Sanjay, Med, Vish, Vikish and chefs Yannick and Shiva for making our stay a memorable one. Definitely recommended for a weekend get away. Will be back soon.Read more

author: Harsah I
comment: Wonderful staff and always very courteous and welcoming. Food and drinks were on top.. Thanks a lot to chef yanick, chef shiva, sanjay, med, vish, vikish and whole team. Room very cosy. Will definitely recommend and be back again very soon.Read more

author: Haley R
comment: After staying at a large scale resort on the west side of the island, salt was SUCH a treat. The beach is absolutely stunning and the staff makes it feel like home. Sanjay and Med helped us for most meals and were so kind and friendly. Kenny helped me train at the gym offering a lovely personalized workout for climbing Kilimanjaro soon. Bavash one of the bartenders was offered implacable service. 10/10 would recommend and come back!Read more

author: Adnan...
comment: Fantastic hotel, good location and good staff. They have a beautiful view of the sea and a lovely pool. the room is a nice size and very clean andThe menu varies and they have very good food. We had the most contact with SanjayHe talked to us and recommended us places we should visit. 10 out of 10 customer serviceRead more

author: Daniel
comment: Stunning location and facilities. Great value for money and friendly service. a very well maintained venue with some great design features. The rooms overlooking the ocean, what a treat. The wine selection could do with a bit of work, the price and quality don't quite match. The food was good but with some minor adjustments could be excellent. Over all an amazing stay.Read more

author: w0rldwidew0man
comment: My husband and I stayed at Salt Hotel in early September and it was our first visit to Mauritius. In our stay with Salt, we experienced a high level of service, comfort, delicious cuisine and activities in one package. Everything was exemplary and we cannot fault anything.The room had an incredible view (Best on beach).  It was very clean, comfortable and practical. The showers are a joy here and we enjoyed a spa-like experience every time. The bed and bedding was the most comfortable we have experienced. There was plenty on offer, whether lazing by the pool or participating in water activities such as snorkelling, pedal boating etc.  There is a lovely stretch of beach for walking.We went for the half board option and meals here were amazing! Breakfast was an excellent start to the day and dinners were a lovely affair. We ate so very well and the Chef was really nice to check up on guests after dinner for feedback and a lovely chat.I think that the best part of our stay was the genuine warmth of the staff who are a real asset to the resort and great ambassadors for the brand. From when we were first greeted at reception, Pratheeka made us feel welcomed and looked after and always made sure to ask how our day was every time we saw her. A big shout out to Rajiv, Bool, Shib, Ved and Derwin for great service in the dining room. Also to Babish at the rooftop bar for delicious cocktails. Thank you to Dev the driver and Mr Gutty (our cab driver) for such fun excursions. Our two spa attendants on Sept 18 (apologies we did not get your names but your hands are magic!) Also to Mallini for keeping the room exceptionally clean and tidy.  Lastly, to Rishi, one of the managers who is a really top guy as he made sure everything during our stay was perfect from giving us advice with the best excursion options and arranging appointments at the spa.  We felt very looked after by him and we are very grateful. In summary, we cannot recommend Salt highly enough for a luxurious tropical getaway and we hope to be back again.Read more

author: Purplelove007
comment: Wonderful warm welcome to this uniquely decorated, beautiful hotel. Amazing staff throughout whole stay. Food was always extremely well presented and delicious. Sun beds, bean bags, hammocks and beach towels all perfect and comfortable. We had bang on the beach room, which was stunning, it was cleaned spotlessly daily, fantastic sea views. No fridge in room which was disappointing. We had bed and breakfast, which had great choices and always extremely tasty.Food and drink at hotel was very high priced, which meant we ate out more, or bought items back to our room. We noted even if full board or all inclusive some things were not included in price, eg smoothies. Was very windy on beach, but if you take a sun bed or bean bag round the corner on beach, wind drops and it’s restful.Read more

author: Jai & Khay
comment: Mersi & Enkosi to an amazing Salt of Palmer team! We have traveled as global citizens and Loyal Marriott Bonvoy Members for years in North and Central America and Asia; truthfully, your Hospitality was some of the best in the world. After our stay, we are excited to share our 5-star experience with our colleagues and loved ones worldwide. Special shoutout to Shib, Vikesh, Kesh, Mr. Bool, Med, Dharam, Kenny, Naina, Sanjay, Rewa, Raju, Lurvish, Roshan, Pradesh, and Anu who cared for us like family. We will be back; if you are an environmentalist, advocate for Local community investments and conscious traveler I highly recommend SALT!Truly,Jai & Khay Sigula-Stephens FamilyRead more

author: David T
comment: The hotel is in an excellent position on the east coast You could walk for a long way on the beach, often bumping into people riding horses.The food was excellent and all the staff were friendly and helpful especially Sanjay. The swimming pool was very inviting and we used it most days.There was always sunbeds available, but not always round the pool.We used the rooftop bar, from which the views were very good(especially looking at the Fruit bats at dusk).Read more

author: Mike A
comment: We’ve thoroughly enjoyed our time at SALT - the hotel itself offers fab decor and lovely clean and spacious rooms. Located on a beautiful stretch of white sandy beach, there’s great snorkelling at your fingertips. The hotel provides loads of information from a guidebook to a tailor-made app to make the whole island accessible and we’ve really loved exploring everything Mauritus has to offer by hire car.We’re particularly grateful to all of the wonderful staff, the whole team here at SALT are really friendly and approachable and have all gone out of their way to make sure our stay was as comfortable as possible. We’ve also been really impressed by the food - the menu is expansive and includes a fab array of traditional Mauritian food, lovely fresh fish and octopus, and a great range of vegan/vegetarian dishes. We’d recommend trying to sample everything they have to offer while you’re here!We’d love to come back and unwind here once again soon and explore more of the wonderful island in the future.Thanks team SALT!Read more

author: Jean Laurent P
comment: We spent 4 days at the salt of palmar for our honeymoon. The service was impeccable, the food out of this world and the view on the ocean breathtaking. The salt is a uniquely designed and decorated hotel, with class and beauty everywhere. Every detail is taken care of and the customer experience is a priority. This is really a 5 star hotel. Definitely recommend!Read more

author: Dave D
comment: We stayed at Salt for three days as part of a longer tour of Mauritius and to be honest I now with that we had booked it for longer and used it as a base. A wonderful hotel.Service: The staff were, without exception, a wonderful group of people. They went out of their way to make sure that our stay was comfortable. Friendly, efficient and attentive.Location: Fabulous. Book a sea view room if you can.Food: Fantastic. Great local and fresh options for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Good drinks selection (and a generous pour if you opt for a glass rather than a bottle!)Overall, we had a lovely stay at the Salt and I would be happy to recommend it to anyone. Looking forward to our next stay!Read more

author: Ilyas A
comment: We spent little over a week for our honeymoon at salt of palmar - although upon arrival checkin was little less than what we imagined the team made up for it with their attentive service and helpfulness - the quality of the food is one of the most unique points of the hotel - locally sourced organic ingredients used for high quality fresh meals. The management team are so alert and friendly and tended to our every need they always made it a point to think of solutions pragmatically - I want to especially thank Rishi for being very professional and helpful in helping with making up for the checkin hassle we faced - the hotel went really above and beyond for us! And we really felt the genuine care a special thanks to Sanjay who always had a smile and made us feel like we were getting extra care! Very funny and welcoming guy! The hotel also offered us a discounted couples spa treatment I have to admit Juliana was really good with the firm massage to get through my knots and put me to sleep! We’re so glad we decided to come to Mauritius in comparison to the other Indian Ocean islands - the Mauritian people were really warm hearted and kind to us everywhere we went.Read more

author: Keatfarm
comment: My wife and I came to Salt for a week to switch off from every day life and to enjoy a relaxing holiday, something we very rarely do. The hotel had some incredible reviews and also ticked a lot of boxes for us and boy it didn't disappoint once we were there. From the moment we walked through the door, a sense of calm came over us, which lasted for our whole stay. The design of this Hotel is beautiful, which is only complemented by the wonderful, friendly and knowledgeable team, who are just incredible. And the food is phenomenal! The whole team always gave us 100% and made us feel very calm and relaxed. They even went the extra mile for us when we had difficulties with our return flight. If Mauritius is on your radar, please make this your No 1 place to stay.Read more

author: kcabsolutely1965
comment: Where to start? First impressions: a grand looking entrance greets you along with staff greeting you with a hand on heart bowed welcome, your first encounter on how lovely all the staff are going to be during your visit. As you step through the door, you can see that pretty much 'every' aspect & item has been designed to be 'Instagramable'... you WILL photograph everything during your stay!!! The place is stunning. Rooms: We chose beachfront rooms and were not disappointed with the views. Huge 'very open' walk-in showers are a nice touch, quirky colours and touches throughout the room with big comfortable bed & pillows. Food & Bar: We were intrigued how the 'All Inclusive' option works as SALT have no buffet, everything including breakfast you order individually from a menu, the idea being no waste. This actually works very well although a 9-day stay exhausts most choices & suggest taking advantage of the daily specials throughout your stay at lunch & dinner. Service is interesting, as mentioned the staff are all fantastic & loveable but our experience found that many of our orders would be lost in translation somewhere between us, the waiter, the chef, the bar, no great mishaps just 'quirky' liveable/ rectifiable ones that weirdly just added to the whole charm of the place... like it wasn't really trying to be 5 star perfect but being that cool boutiquey place you just chill in. Beach: White sands, plenty of beds with  beautiful views & towels aplenty. Boat House with again nice friendly helpful staff for your water sport needs, highly recommend the free daily boat trip out to Snorkel in the coral. Pool & Roof Bar: Take a look at the photos... picture perfect. Spa: We all enjoyed a 60 minute treatment each designed to our individual needs, the experience ends with a relaxing chill in their SALT room, salt crystal floor, illuminated colour changing solid salt brick work surrounds you. Negatives: Not really. Personally I would suggest that both the food menu & bar menu financially doesn't need so many * items (i.e not included in all-inclusive)  e.g being a small or large draft lager is included but a small draft ale/beer is not? Positives: Stunning modern design with loveable staff making your stay a very enjoyable one!!Thank you.Read more

author: chloe floyd
comment: My partner and I come to Mauritius every year to visit his family and always love to try new hotels along the way!!!I can say that we received the utmost amazing service from ALL staff and nothing was ever too much for them! They were so kind caring and also very fun to talk to and laugh with making me feel so comfortable along with my partner throughout our stay! We definitely will be back! Here are a few names from the most amazing staff here that deserve the most recognition! - Dervin- Sanjay- Rewa- Fayaaz- Rajiv - Shib - Bhavish- Ved- Vish- Med - Raju From working in the hospitality industry myself it’s a hardworking and stressful job! We’re  so proud of you all and thank you so much for everything you do! Keep up the hard work you are all doing amazing! ❤️Read more

author: Kirsty D
comment: Staff were very welcoming, attentive and friendly. We had breakfast during our stay and the occasional dinner, the food was a delicious blend of local cuisine, expertly cooked and presented. Most nights had a theme, which was fun, and there were great vegan/veggie options too. A shout out to our favourite waiter, Sanjay, for looking after us during our trip. Our hotel room was nice, no ocean view unfortunately, a bit noisy at times, and a warning about no tv or shower curtain/door! The hotel was intimate and cosy with a lovely pool which captured the sun most of the day, but the show stopper for us was the beach. Crystal blue water, hardly any waves and beautiful coral & sealife to snorkel and discover. The hotel offered complimentary snorkelling and glass bottom boat trips, which we took advantage of, as well as free kayak, SUP and pedalo’s to rent. A nice surprise was the hotel’s itinerary of activities ranging from the usual volleyball and yoga to bath fizz making and cocktail classes. A very nice touch and a great way to meet fellow guests.Read more

author: GUY D
comment: Our 3rd visit in two years.We have travelled the globe and not received an experience as Salt of Palmar, Mauritius.From Raj and Rishi who make things work 24/7  are on site daily,With staff as Med, Vish and so many more will make your stay a memory to never forget.The service, staff, rooms, food especially, the paradise view when you arrive.We are already looking to come back as we we have made Salt of Palmar our home in Mauritius.Huge thanks to absolutely every staff member.We will see you all again very soon.Regards Guy and Anne DoddsRead more

author: Guy D
comment: Our 3rd trip in two years.We have travelled the globe and for service, staff, rooms and absolutely everything about Salt of Palmar is fabulous and way beyond our experience elsewhere.Raj and Rishi run the show but are always are on site to assist and keep the wheels turning 24/7.Staff members are too many to mention.As you walk through the front door you are looking at paradise.So.. we are now looking to book our 4th trip.Huge thanks to everyone at Salt, our home in Mauritius Guy Dodds and Anne GoddardRead more

author: kulvinderbahra
comment: This hotel was booked within 2 months of travel, through Trailfinders. I was excited to go for a restful break, and thought it would serve this purpose. The hotel has a concept, a homely feel without a reception desk. In its place is a gift shop, a library room and an open sitting foyer. The hotel is comfortable, clean and the staff are attentive when you get their attention. There are a lot of staff in the restaurant and bar. The restaurant staff Med, Vineet, Anshika, Prince and Vishram the chef I met were very hospitable, and the food is wholesome, with good sized portions. Sometimes I asked to pack the food, and it was never a problem - too much to eat, and I didn’t want to waste. The absence of the reception meant you had to hover around waiting for someone to appear to help with your query. Contacting them through their phone app was their preferred way of comms, not ideal if you’re looking for a digital detox! I paid half board, and saw that nearly half the dishes are excluded, and if I wanted to order, especially fish or seafood, it’s at a 25% discount. The price of drinks and coconut water was extortionate. It is a very expensive hotel to stay at, for the amenities you don’t get. The bar staff either chose to give crisps with your drinks or not. I asked, so I received. No tablet in the room as advertised to watch netflix. No mini fridge to keep drinks or fruit/food cool, but I did request one. No iron, or ironing board until requested. Rubber flip flops would be useful in bedrooms, rather than the room slippers. The sea at the hotel has rocks, and is windy, so water activities are more difficult, although included in the price you pay. Walk to the right, and have water shoes with you, and you’ll enjoy the endless soft sanded beaches and views. They charge 15% tax on the cost of all items booked through the hotel, and they take a flat amount on credit card of 14000 Mauritian rupees. I had underspent, and I was told I would need to spend up to the amount or I wouldn’t receive a refund. I tried to pay the amount owed in cash - euros and rupees, I was told this couldn’t be accepted, as the euros would be charged with commission on top of the 15% I’d already paid. So I bought a coffee and a snack to meet the 14000 amount to pay with my credit card. All in all, a safe happy memorable trip, with verbal feedback given to the concierge to improve the reception experience on arrival if a guest arrives in the morning and the room will be available at 2pm.Read more

author: mike_piercy
comment: As so many reviewers have said: the hotel is lovely, the food is fantastic and the customer service is excellent.However two things really annoyed me and would stop me going back. Firstly the cost of drinks is outrageous. A draft beer costs over £10 and the cheapest bottle of wine is over £50 - for a bottle I could buy in our supermarket for £9.Secondly the food plans are very restrictive. We chose the Full Board plan but found that nearly half the items on the menu are excluded from the plan. Nearly all the seafood dishes are excluded. I would not mind so much if you could buy the excluded items for a small supplement, but no you have to pay the full price less 25%. The whole point of a food plan is that you can budget for your holiday and not have to watch costs building up during your stay.Read more

author: Oliver B
comment: This is without doubt one of the best hotels we have stayed in to date. This "boutique" hotel is created on the basis that it is a high-quality restaurant managed by Chef Shiva & his team. The attention to your stay is never too much for any of the pleasant staff.We enjoyed every element of our stay, enough to do with trips outside the hotel, and as we wanted to have a relaxing holiday, staying in the hotel around the exclusive pool and beach was great.This hotel should get the recognition and plaudits it and the team deserve.To mention just a few - Shiva, Visham, Sanjay, Shib, Vish, Rajiv, Raju, and of course Vikishrama.Read more

author: Tanishta
comment: Our stay at Salt of Palmar was a truly remarkable experience, made even more special by the incredible team and unique offerings that set this place apart.A standout feature was our time in the Himalayan Salt Room. This was our first experience, and it was absolutely incredible. Relaxing in this serene space not only helped us unwind but also offered noticeable health benefits like improved breathing and a sense of calm. It was a one-of-a-kind experience we will always remember and highly recommend to anyone visiting Salt of Palmar.The team at the hotel deserves endless praise. Juliana’s spa treatments were pure magic—her expertise and care left us feeling utterly rejuvenated.Sanjay played a key role in helping us choose the perfect meals. His deep knowledge of the menu and understanding of our preferences made every dining experience flawless.Vikash welcomed us with an exclusive and warm PR touch, ensuring we felt like royalty throughout our stay.Chef Shiva personally checked in during each meal to ensure we loved the food. He graciously took our feedback as valuable input, showing his commitment to delivering culinary excellence. His passion for his craft shone through every dish.Mr. Dharam, with his vibrant and enthusiastic energy, made every moment a joy. His lively and cheerful service elevated our overall experience.Salt of Palmar is not just a hotel—it’s a destination that redefines hospitality. The personalized care, thoughtful experiences like the Himalayan Salt Room, and the dedication of the entire team made our stay unforgettable. We’re already looking forward to our next visit!Read more

author: Flyer14732030793
comment: Salt of Palme lifted the benchmark for excellence to another level.Staff, chef, rooms, view, food, spa, beach to name a few are of the best quality.Place to rest with peaceful surroundings and excellent yoga on the beach.Already planning to go back next year. TaniaRead more

author: Tomoko G
comment: We spent lovely 10days at the Salt of Palmar. All the staff were very friendly and welcoming. The food was exquisite and the room/bed mattress was so comfortable. We enjoyed yoga and gym sessions which was very beneficial and enjoyable. Kenny was an excellent gym coach. On our last day I did spa massage. The spa therapist Juliana was so skilful and professional. I must say it was one of the best massage I have ever had!! I highly recommend her if anyone wants a best massage. Over all it was a most relaxing holiday for us. Lastly, I have enjoyed the art sessions with Danny who helped my first acrylic paintings and I could bring back beautiful memories of Mauritius staying at The Salt .Read more

author: Ilyas A
comment: We spent little over a week for our honeymoon at salt of palmar - although upon arrival checkin was little less than what we imagined the team made up for it with their attentive service and helpfulness - the quality of the food is one of the most unique points of the hotel - locally sourced organic ingredients used for high quality fresh meals. The management team are so alert and friendly and tended to our every need they always made it a point to think of solutions pragmatically - I want to especially thank Rishi for being very professional and helpful in helping with making up for the checkin hassle we faced - the hotel went really above and beyond for us! And we really felt the genuine care a special thanks to Sanjay who always had a smile and made us feel like we were getting extra care! Very funny and welcoming guy! The hotel also offered us a discounted couples spa treatment I have to admit Juliana was really good with the firm massage to get through my knots and put me to sleep! We’re so glad we decided to come to Mauritius in comparison to the other Indian Ocean islands - the Mauritian people were really warm hearted and kind to us everywhere we went.Read more

author: Keatfarm
comment: My wife and I came to Salt for a week to switch off from every day life and to enjoy a relaxing holiday, something we very rarely do. The hotel had some incredible reviews and also ticked a lot of boxes for us and boy it didn't disappoint once we were there. From the moment we walked through the door, a sense of calm came over us, which lasted for our whole stay. The design of this Hotel is beautiful, which is only complemented by the wonderful, friendly and knowledgeable team, who are just incredible. And the food is phenomenal! The whole team always gave us 100% and made us feel very calm and relaxed. They even went the extra mile for us when we had difficulties with our return flight. If Mauritius is on your radar, please make this your No 1 place to stay.Read more

author: kcabsolutely1965
comment: Where to start? First impressions: a grand looking entrance greets you along with staff greeting you with a hand on heart bowed welcome, your first encounter on how lovely all the staff are going to be during your visit. As you step through the door, you can see that pretty much 'every' aspect & item has been designed to be 'Instagramable'... you WILL photograph everything during your stay!!! The place is stunning. Rooms: We chose beachfront rooms and were not disappointed with the views. Huge 'very open' walk-in showers are a nice touch, quirky colours and touches throughout the room with big comfortable bed & pillows. Food & Bar: We were intrigued how the 'All Inclusive' option works as SALT have no buffet, everything including breakfast you order individually from a menu, the idea being no waste. This actually works very well although a 9-day stay exhausts most choices & suggest taking advantage of the daily specials throughout your stay at lunch & dinner. Service is interesting, as mentioned the staff are all fantastic & loveable but our experience found that many of our orders would be lost in translation somewhere between us, the waiter, the chef, the bar, no great mishaps just 'quirky' liveable/ rectifiable ones that weirdly just added to the whole charm of the place... like it wasn't really trying to be 5 star perfect but being that cool boutiquey place you just chill in. Beach: White sands, plenty of beds with  beautiful views & towels aplenty. Boat House with again nice friendly helpful staff for your water sport needs, highly recommend the free daily boat trip out to Snorkel in the coral. Pool & Roof Bar: Take a look at the photos... picture perfect. Spa: We all enjoyed a 60 minute treatment each designed to our individual needs, the experience ends with a relaxing chill in their SALT room, salt crystal floor, illuminated colour changing solid salt brick work surrounds you. Negatives: Not really. Personally I would suggest that both the food menu & bar menu financially doesn't need so many * items (i.e not included in all-inclusive)  e.g being a small or large draft lager is included but a small draft ale/beer is not? Positives: Stunning modern design with loveable staff making your stay a very enjoyable one!!Thank you.Read more

author: chloe floyd
comment: My partner and I come to Mauritius every year to visit his family and always love to try new hotels along the way!!!I can say that we received the utmost amazing service from ALL staff and nothing was ever too much for them! They were so kind caring and also very fun to talk to and laugh with making me feel so comfortable along with my partner throughout our stay! We definitely will be back! Here are a few names from the most amazing staff here that deserve the most recognition! - Dervin- Sanjay- Rewa- Fayaaz- Rajiv - Shib - Bhavish- Ved- Vish- Med - Raju From working in the hospitality industry myself it’s a hardworking and stressful job! We’re  so proud of you all and thank you so much for everything you do! Keep up the hard work you are all doing amazing! ❤️Read more

author: Kirsty D
comment: Staff were very welcoming, attentive and friendly. We had breakfast during our stay and the occasional dinner, the food was a delicious blend of local cuisine, expertly cooked and presented. Most nights had a theme, which was fun, and there were great vegan/veggie options too. A shout out to our favourite waiter, Sanjay, for looking after us during our trip. Our hotel room was nice, no ocean view unfortunately, a bit noisy at times, and a warning about no tv or shower curtain/door! The hotel was intimate and cosy with a lovely pool which captured the sun most of the day, but the show stopper for us was the beach. Crystal blue water, hardly any waves and beautiful coral & sealife to snorkel and discover. The hotel offered complimentary snorkelling and glass bottom boat trips, which we took advantage of, as well as free kayak, SUP and pedalo’s to rent. A nice surprise was the hotel’s itinerary of activities ranging from the usual volleyball and yoga to bath fizz making and cocktail classes. A very nice touch and a great way to meet fellow guests.Read more

author: GUY D
comment: Our 3rd visit in two years.We have travelled the globe and not received an experience as Salt of Palmar, Mauritius.From Raj and Rishi who make things work 24/7  are on site daily,With staff as Med, Vish and so many more will make your stay a memory to never forget.The service, staff, rooms, food especially, the paradise view when you arrive.We are already looking to come back as we we have made Salt of Palmar our home in Mauritius.Huge thanks to absolutely every staff member.We will see you all again very soon.Regards Guy and Anne DoddsRead more

author: Guy D
comment: Our 3rd trip in two years.We have travelled the globe and for service, staff, rooms and absolutely everything about Salt of Palmar is fabulous and way beyond our experience elsewhere.Raj and Rishi run the show but are always are on site to assist and keep the wheels turning 24/7.Staff members are too many to mention.As you walk through the front door you are looking at paradise.So.. we are now looking to book our 4th trip.Huge thanks to everyone at Salt, our home in Mauritius Guy Dodds and Anne GoddardRead more

comment: Our experience at salt of Palmar surpassed all expectations. Being a boutique hotel, the staff catered to our every need and really took the time and effort to know us and learn our preferences. We would like to specifically thank: Rishi, Dervin, Ved, Bhavish, Kenny, Vish, Sanjay, Dharam, Qwelynn and Anshika for going above and beyond each day. Their attention to details far exceeded our expectations. Mauritius is a magical place with outstanding vistas. You will never regret visiting and spending your time at the Salt of Palmar.Read more
